content: 1. The herb He Shou Wu (Polygonum multiflorum, also known as Fo-ti) has specific dosing recommendations based on its indications. For raw herb preparations, the recommended dosage is 9-15 grams. It is commonly used as an adaptogen, for constipation relief, and for its purported anti-aging properties. 2. Fo-ti has been observed to enhance the effects of acarbose through pharmacodynamic synergism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 3.
